newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Creditanstalt takes up $90 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Creditanstalt takes up $90 mln loan.

text.p: Hungary's Creditanstalt Rt, a subsidiary of Austria's Creditanstalt Bankverein, has taken up a $90 million syndicated loan from international markets, Creditanstalt said in a statement on Friday.
The loan, which was organised by Bankgesellschaft Berlin, has three years' maturity and bears a coupon 17 basis points above LIBOR, it said.
"This is the most favourable interest on the Hungarian market to date," it added.
The bank originally wanted to tap markets for $50 million but raised the amount to almost double due to oversubscription.
Creditanstalt will use the loan to finance investments of its corporate clients, it added.
